scope: Offline measurement/reference and noise diagnosis only; no optimizer, GP, acquisition, inference, GUI or real-machine changes
repeat_interpretation: Independent simulated particle populations at fixed controls; no camera noise or real-machine repeatability claim
reference_policy: Use named SDDS x/xp/p columns and the same shared beam-matrix solver for every width stream; retain nonphysical results without projection or rejection
failure_policy: Never clip negative observations or discard failed queries, fits, reconstructions or repeats; preserve partial evidence
continuation: Freeze all evidence regardless of gates. Measurement and noise failures keep GUI/optimization acceptance blocked. Any replacement measurement/noise model requires a new config and output directory; P2-B2 remains immutable.
